import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 12, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
ink = "#263238" blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" slate = "#657786"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5.4, 4.4)) ax = fig.add_axes([0.035, 0.045, 0.93, 0.92]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.28, 1.92) ax.set_ylim(-1.52, 1.24) ax.axis("off")
# Dimensionless drawing coordinates; the pose and vector lengths are # schematic, not measured values or relative force magnitudes. theta_draw = np.deg2rad(40) O = np.zeros(2) P = np.array([np.sin(theta_draw), -np.cos(theta_draw)]) e_r = P.copy() e_theta = np.array([np.cos(theta_draw), np.sin(theta_draw)]) inward = -e_r
# Circular constraint and radial reference. ax.add_patch(Circle(O, 1, fill=False, edgecolor=blue, linewidth=1.65, zorder=1)) ax.plot([0, 0], [0, -1.10], color=slate, linewidth=1.1, linestyle=(0, (3, 3)), zorder=0) ax.plot([0, P[0]], [0, P[1]], color=slate, linewidth=1.25, zorder=2)
ax.text(-0.94, 0.66, r"$r=L$", color=blue, ha="left", va="bottom") ax.text(0.19, -0.13, r"$L$", ha="left", va="center", color=ink)
# Generalized angle measured from the vertical downward direction. a = np.linspace(0, theta_draw, 80) angle_radius = 0.29 ax.plot(angle_radius * np.sin(a), -angle_radius * np.cos(a), color=ink, linewidth=1.15, zorder=3) ax.text(0.065, -0.385, r"$q=\theta$", fontsize=11, ha="center", va="center", color=ink)
def vector(start, end, color, linewidth=1.8): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=14, linewidth=linewidth, color=color, shrinkA=4, shrinkB=0, zorder=5 ) ax.add_patch(patch)
# Normal constraint force, tangential virtual displacement, and gravity. vector(P, P + 0.64 * inward, blue) vector(P, P + 0.63 * e_theta, teal) vector(P, P + np.array([0, -0.59]), ink)
ax.text(0.32, -0.555, r"$\mathbf{F}_c$", color=blue, ha="right", va="center") ax.text(1.16, -0.235, r"$\delta\mathbf{r}=L\delta\theta\,\mathbf{e}_{\theta}$", color=teal, fontsize=11, ha="center", va="bottom") ax.text(0.76, -1.15, r"$\mathbf{F}^{(a)}=m\mathbf{g}$", color=ink, fontsize=11, ha="left", va="center")
# Right-angle marker in the inward-normal/tangent quadrant. s = 0.105 corner = np.vstack([ P + s * inward, P + s * (inward + e_theta), P + s * e_theta ]) ax.plot(corner[:, 0], corner[:, 1], color=slate, linewidth=1.15, zorder=6)
# Pivot and bead. ax.add_patch(Circle(O, 0.026, facecolor=ink, edgecolor="none", zorder=7)) ax.text(-0.065, 0.065, r"$O$", ha="right", va="bottom", color=ink) ax.add_patch(Circle(P, 0.048, facecolor=ink, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.7, zorder=8)) ax.text(P[0] - 0.085, P[1] - 0.075, r"$m$", ha="right", va="top", color=ink)
